summary: Operational creditor's Section 9 IBC application dismissed as time-barred; exclusion of limitation period during SICA suspension disputed; Sick Industrial Companies Act Section 22(1) moratorium on coercive proceedings but no cause of action suspension; pre-existing dispute over gas supply shortfall and disconnection losses; demand notice and application discrepancies on debt quantum and default date; IBC applicability post-SICA repeal; three-year limitation period under Limitation Act Article 137 applied.
legal_provisions_cited: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 s.7; s.8; s.9; s.62
Sick Industrial Companies (Special Provisions) Act, 1985 s.22(1); s.22(5); s.16; s.17
final_judgment: Appeal dismissed; NCLAT judgment upholding time-barred Section 9 application and existence of pre-existing dispute confirmed.
